sources.title: Grafana Assistant Managed Sandboxes
sources.verification_notes: Grafana sandbox provider separates task launch approval from publication. Sandbox commands cannot directly push/open PRs. Ask-before-publishing or auto-publish draft PRs for verified private repositories; merge remains in GitHub. External Cursor/Claude providers use their own repository permissions; the same publication restriction must not be generalized to them.

sources.title: Incident-Arena
sources.basis: author paper v1, sections 3.3 and 4, plus version history
sources.verification_notes: Newly read on 2026-10-21, not a new post-10/17 release. 20 tasks across Frappe, Saleor and an author-built Slack-like service. Outcome and safety gates must both pass; reference fixes pass and no-op fails. 60-minute execution then workload-cycle-aligned 180-second agent-free graded soak. Ranking/token/failure-aggregate statistics omitted because abstract/body and failure tables have inconsistent counts. Benchmark was not executed for this article.
